text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED by ryan-oncall — p99 streaming stalls + p95 spike observed for /v1/generate since 2026-11-03T14:02Z (alert: latency-service-p99 > 1.2s)

ryan-oncall: seeing large tail across a handful of customers, streaming stalls (~10-30s stalls) and some clients are hitting our retry logic. p95 jumped from 180ms to ~1.1s. p99 ~3.6s.

jessica.eng: thanks — any change rolled recently? I see a prefix-hash rollout finished ~13:58Z (kv-prefix v2.3) that touched streaming cache keys.

mike-platform: yep we rolled prefix-hash v2.3 to 60% at 13:50 and to 100% at 13:56. The change altered the prefix derivation for cached KV entries (added tenant hash salt).

alex.sre: metrics link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/latency-service-p99 — check cache hit-rate for streaming-prefetch and prefixcache_kv_hit_ratio.

ryan-oncall: digging into cache metrics: prefixcache_kv_hit_ratio dropped from 89% -> 12% around 13:55. streaming-prefetch miss rate spike matches. Looks like the rollout invalidated existing prefixes.

kate-cs: two enterprise customers reported degraded UX, tickets 9832 and 9841, both on Dedicated. They got elevated errors from client SDKs due to stalls. CS is pinged.

jessica.eng: immediate mitigation: can we flip the prefix-hash rollout to previous version or enable compatibility mode to accept both prefixes?

mike-platform: pushing rollback now — initiating abort for v2.3 rollout and forcing v2.2. Command: `platform rollout abort --component=kv-prefix --target=stable`

incident-bot: Rollback job started (job id rjob-20261103-77a). Estimated 30s to finish for control plane, 2m for full propagation.

alex.sre: meanwhile enable best-effort fallback in runtime: accept legacy prefix keys when miss occurs. Deploy patch to serving runtime: `enable_prefix_compat=true` to avoid cold misses. Patching canary now.

jessica.eng: patch applied to 5% canary. Observability: prefixcache_kv_hit_ratio -> 41% within 45s in canary shard.

ryan-oncall: rollback finished at 14:07Z per platform. Control plane reports v2.2 active. global prefix cache hit ratio climbing: 68% at 14:10Z, p95 back to ~240ms, p99 ~1.1s and still trending down.

kate-cs: notifying affected customers with note: "Mitigation in progress; we're rolling back a cache prefix change that caused stalls. Expect normal behavior within minutes. Will follow up with RCA."

mike-platform: post-rollback we should run a small integrity pass to rebuild any stale KV TTLs that may have been evicted. Running `kvscan --reindex-prefixes --concurrency=8 --since=2026-11-03T13:40Z` now.

alex.sre: log snippet from edge node: ``[2026-11-03T13:56:12Z] cache-miss prefix=tenant:abc:stream:... backend-miss reason=prefix-mismatch`` — a lot of these around the single shard 10. Investigating hotshard skew.

ryan-oncall: paging note: team alerted oncall-sre for shard 10 to look at OS-level paging. Observed short spikes in page_faults coinciding with stalls, probably due to mass cache cold-starts causing memory churn.

jessica.eng: mitigation checklist: 1) Rollback prefix rollout — done. 2) Enable prefix compatibility in runtime — canary -> broadened to 50% now. 3) Reindex KV prefixes — started. 4) Monitor p95/p99 and streaming stall events.

mike-platform: reindex finished for primary zones at 14:18Z. Verification logs show `reindexed 1.2M keys, restored hit-rate to 86% for affected prefixes`.

visit-link: Observability dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/streaming-prefix-incident?from=1660... (shortlink posted)

alex.sre: tail latency now p99=420ms and dropping. No more streaming stalls in last 5m. Will keep monitoring for 30m.

ryan-oncall: handoff plan — I'm taking memory and paging follow-ups for next 30m. alex.sre will continue watch on tail latency and reindex completeness. Next oncall (jessica) please pick up long-term RCA and write postmortem drafts.

jessica.eng: ack, will start RCA: initial hypothesis = incompatible prefix-hash change + stale TTLs -> mass cache misses -> memory churn -> paging spikes -> streaming stalls. Will collect timelines, rollout audit, and propose safer rollout pattern + automatic compat flag for future prefix schema changes.

kate-cs: CS update sent to customers at 14:25Z. No new escalations.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (closed by ryan-oncall) at 2026-11-03T14:30Z — severity lowered to S2, follow-up required: RCA + postmortem.

ryan-oncall: final notes: consider adding rollout guard that measures prefixcache_kv_hit_ratio in real-time and auto-pauses if hit-rate drops >20% within 2 minutes. Also add a small canary window that verifies compatibility across multiple tenants before full rollout.

jessica.eng: will file RFC for rollout-compatibility and automation. I'll tag eng-runtime, eng-platform, and eng-sre.

mike-platform: +1 on auto-pause. Also add a synthetic test that validates cache key derivation against a sample of live keys before flipping flags.

alex.sre: leaving watch for 30m, will hand back to rotation at 15:00Z if stable. :thumbsup:

ryan-oncall: thanks everyone — great fast response. Closing thread.
